# Delivery routing ruling (e2e synthetic)

Tanya (team owner) ruled on where reaction delivery belongs:

> we route every reaction through one bundle per run per person, not one
> message per skill — a person should get one thing to read, not four

Tina pushed back on the batching window and Tanya held: the bundle closes when
the run closes, and a skill that misses the close waits for the next run rather
than sending on its own. The alternative considered and rejected was per-skill
delivery with client-side collapsing, which moves the ordering problem onto the
reader.

payload.focus: Delivery routing ruling: reactions bundled one per run per person, not per-skill; batching window closes with run; ordering problem kept server-side not client-side. Tanya team owner decision, Tina pushback on batching window.
payload.rationale: The delivery routing ruling is an architecture decision that extends the anti-Slack, anti-noise positioning (one bundle not four messages = one thing to read), so Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat are load-bearing. The 'one thing to read, not four' principle extends Narrative_ZeroEffortCapture from capture to delivery. Position_WebhookArchitecture is the closest existing architecture decision and the ruling is in the same event-driven vein. Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus and Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture provide the capture context that delivery is downstream of. Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate and Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint relate because bundling preserves a single readable artifact (context preservation). Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform frames the bundle-per-run as an async delivery pattern. Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock and Position_Sprint4ThesisProven are included because delivery routing affects how integrations deliver and extends the proven thesis. Position_PricingTier25Plus is included as part of the ZeroEffortCapture narrative cluster. I deliberately did not expand Position_PricingTwelveDollars (superseded by the tier pricing) or Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams (no direct bearing on delivery mechanics).
